rule: consolidated from saved predictions; no model was trained or re-fitted

rows.note: CV read from ablation.json (fold models re-fitted inside Part 9A, fused OOF not saved); macro precision not stored there; macro recall = balanced accuracy

findings: Strongest single modality on test: DOM-only (macro-F1 0.786, 95 % CI [0.652, 0.891]); weakest: Content-only (Text XLM-R) (0.657).

The ranking depends on the evaluation: on CV (391 pages) the strongest single row is Content-only (Text TF-IDF) (macro-F1 0.706 ± 0.065) and DOM-only reaches 0.701 ± 0.077; the mean ± std ranges overlap.
benign (test n = 34): best single DOM-only F1 0.89, weakest Content-only (Text XLM-R) 0.79.
phishing (test n = 13): best single Content-only (Text TF-IDF) F1 0.81, weakest Content-only (Text XLM-R) 0.64.
fake_ecommerce (test n = 8): best single DOM-only F1 1.00, weakest Content-only (Text XLM-R) 0.70.
crypto_scam (test n = 4): best single Content-only (Text XLM-R) F1 0.73, weakest Behavior-only 0.29.
malware_delivery (test n = 9): best single Behavior-only F1 0.67, weakest Content-only (Text TF-IDF) 0.36.

Benign FPR on test (argmax, 34 benign pages): Content-only (Text TF-IDF) 5.9 %, Tri-modal fusion (reference) 8.8 %, DOM-only 17.6 %, Behavior-only 20.6 %, Content-only (Text XLM-R) 23.5 %. No row meets the ≤ 2 % target at argmax.
Text XLM-R (final seed) test macro-F1 0.657; over 3 seeds 0.610 ± 0.062, below Text TF-IDF (0.718).

Complementarity (test, 68 pages, 4 single rows): all right 34, all wrong 4; pages only one row gets right: DOM-only 2, Content-only (Text TF-IDF) 1, Content-only (Text XLM-R) 1, Behavior-only 1. Oracle (any single right) 94.1 % vs tri-modal 83.8 % accuracy.

Tri-modal reference: test macro-F1 0.795 [0.654, 0.906], benign FPR 8.8 %. Tri-modal minus each single row (paired bootstrap): DOM-only +0.009 [-0.136, +0.141] (CI includes 0); Content-only (Text TF-IDF) +0.077 [-0.019, +0.201] (CI includes 0); Content-only (Text XLM-R) +0.138 [+0.053, +0.249]; Behavior-only +0.113 [-0.013, +0.227] (CI includes 0).
limitations: Small test set: 68 pages. Test macro-F1 95 % CIs are 0.24, 0.27, 0.26, 0.25, 0.25 wide (rows in table order); one page moves accuracy by 1.5 points.
The tri-modal gain over DOM-only, Content-only (Text TF-IDF), Behavior-only is not established: those paired-bootstrap CIs include 0.
Few test pages per threat class (benign 34, phishing 13, fake_ecommerce 8, crypto_scam 4, malware_delivery 9); per-class F1 of the small classes changes by large steps with one page.
Few non-English test pages: si 1, ta 1, mixed 1, other 14 (Part 5A detected language). Per-language accuracy for si / ta / mixed is anecdotal; no Sinhala / Tamil claim can be made from this test set.

The tri-modal CV row is read from the Part 9A ablation (fused OOF was not saved); its CV macro precision is not available. The fusion's arm OOF came from arm models that saw the fusion's held-out fold (standard stacking, not fully nested).
Part 6B (intent-level text classification) is pending; Content-only here is the page-level 6A classifier.

Behavior-only is a page-class classifier over static-JS / behavior features; the behavior pattern detection-rate evaluation (real-page benchmark) is preliminary (small n) and is not part of these numbers.
All metrics are at argmax. The benign-FPR operating point (≤ 2 % on OOF) of the Part 9A / 9B reports is not re-evaluated here.
